claims.evidence: The witness confirmed the LG logo but did not specify if the screen is the 'Flatron' (flat-surface) variety.
The witness reported the screen is dark/off and the unit is very dusty.
The visual condition described by the witness aligns with an item intended for scrap.

risks.risk: Internal components like the copper yoke or circuit boards may have been scavenged.
risks.proof: A photo of the rear of the TV showing an intact, untampered casing and sticker.
risks.if_unproven: as an empty plastic and glass shell.

risks.risk: The CRT glass may be cracked or severely scratched under the dust.
risks.proof: A photo of the screen after being wiped clean with a damp cloth.

risks.risk: The size/model is unknown, affecting the volume of recyclable materials.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's sticker on the back panel.
risks.if_unproven: as the smallest standard LG CRT model.

proof_requests: Photo of the sticker on the back of the TV to identify the model and screen size.
Photo of the screen after the dust has been wiped off.
Photo of the back and sides to ensure the casing is not cracked or opened.
response.reason: The item is identified as an LG CRT and the seller admits it is scrap, allowing for a valuation based on its lowest possible recycling/parts value.
